in_sanskrit.name: Havoc
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Disorder, Chaos
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Havoc एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Havoc is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'hava' meaning 'wind' and 'kshana' meaning 'moment'. This name symbolizes the sudden and uncontrollable chaos and disorder that can occur in a moment's time, often used in Hindu mythology to describe the destructive power of gods.
